body:
When I run [nvflare simulator path.../NVFlare/examples/hello-numpy-sag/app -w /tmp/nvflare/workspace_folder/ -n 8 -t 1] in gitbash, I confront the error of 

> [ERROR - run_client_thread error: module 'os' has no attribute 'setsid']

How to fix it? Thanks.

comments.body: @pygabc1 Could you please let us know which environment were you running the "nvflare simulator ..." command? Were you running in a Linux system? or a Windows system? or Mac OS?
@pygabc1  we haven't heard from you, can you provide some information, so we can help

@yhwen the user is not responding, but I googled the gitbash he mentioned, I found this 

https://www.git-tower.com/learn/git/faq/git-bash#:~:text=The%20name%20indicates%20that%20%22Git,shell%20on%20macOS%20and%20Linux.

"Git Bash, quite simply, is an application for Microsoft Windows that emulates the "original" Git version control system as it was built for Unix-style environments. ..."

So its something running on Windows. We never tested in this env. before. Not sure we can support this.

hi I could provide more information based on this issue. 

The problem is triggered by `Windows` OS.  I don't think there is a way to solve the problem. `os.setsid()` is not supported in windows.
As far as I know, currently we are not planning to support Windows, we might support it in the future.

title: 'setsid' error
